fruits.description: EVERY fruit instance visible in the image, ripe or not, including partially occluded ones.

bbox.description: Bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2] of the whole fruit, including the parts hidden behind leaves or other fruit. Fruit body only: exclude the calyx and stem when they sit apart from the fruit; a calyx lying flat on the fruit is inside.

confidence_pct.description: How confident you are that this really is a fruit instance of the asked kind.
